name: ask_user
description: Ask the user a structured question with selectable options. Use when you need a decision from the user before proceeding.

question.description: Clear question to ask the user.

options.description: 2-8 choices. An 'Other (type manually)' option is appended automatically — do not add it yourself.

default.description: Pre-selected option index (0-based). Must be < number of options.
